description: Source code for MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer class, which manages creation, destruction, and configuration testing of media player instances for maximum resource utilization in a media playback testing context.

classes.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer
classes.description: Class responsible for exploring maximum configurations of media players with different resource constraints.

methods.name: CalculateMaxTestConfigs
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum resource configurations for testing.

methods.name: IsConfigCreatable
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration of player instances can be created within resource limits.

methods.name: CreatePlayerInstance
methods.description: Creates a media player instance based on a given configuration.

methods.name: DestroyPlayerInstance
methods.description: Destroys a given media player instance.
